title: 第二十一章 名片第二十章 停车场
lines: 碎片在地上被风吹散之后，沈南枝以为这事就过去了。
没有。
第二天下午，店里来了一个人。五十来岁的男人，穿着黑色大衣，头发梳得一丝不苟，手里提着一个棕色的皮包。进门先看了一圈，目光在货架上扫了一遍，最后落在柜台后面的沈南枝身上。
“请问是沈南枝沈老板吗？”
“我是。”
“我姓梁，是陆先生的律师。”他从皮包里拿出一张名片，双手递过来。名片上印着“梁志恒，陆氏集团法律顾问”，地址是港城中环的一栋写字楼。
沈南枝接过名片，看了一眼，放在柜台上。
“哪个陆先生？”
“陆经纶先生。”梁志恒在椅子上坐下来，把皮包放在腿上，动作很自然，好像这里是他自己的办公室，“陆先生让我来跟您谈谈。”
“谈什么？”
“谈陆沉舟。”
沈南枝靠在柜台后面，看着他，没说话。
梁志恒从皮包里拿出一个文件夹，翻开，里面夹着几页纸。他没递给沈南枝，而是放在桌上，用手指按着。
“陆沉舟是陆经纶先生的儿子，这件事您应该已经知道了。陆先生年事已高，希望儿子回去继承家业。但陆沉舟拒绝回港城，原因——梁志恒顿了一下，看着沈南枝，“跟您有关。”
“跟我有什么关系？”
“他说他在京海有事要做。”
沈南枝的手指在柜台下面慢慢收紧了。
“他的事，你找他谈。找我干什么？”
梁志恒把文件夹合上，放回皮包里。他从大衣内袋里掏出一个信封，放在桌上，推到沈南枝面前。信封是白色的，没有字，鼓鼓囊囊的。
“这是陆先生的一点心意。只要您劝陆沉舟回港城，还有更多。”
沈南枝看着那个信封，没动。
“你们陆家的人，是不是都觉得什么事都能用钱摆平？”
梁志恒的表情没变，还是那种职业性的微笑。
“沈老板，您别误会。陆先生没有别的意思，只是希望儿子回家。您跟陆沉舟的关系，我们都了解。您说的话，他听得进去。”
沈南枝拿起那个信封，在手里掂了掂，不轻。她没拆，把信封放回桌上，推回去。
“你拿回去。我跟陆沉舟没有关系。他是他，我是我。他回不回去，他自己说了算，我说了不算。”
梁志恒看着她，目光在她脸上停了两秒，点了点头，把信封收回皮包里。站起来，拉了拉大衣的下摆，把皱褶抚平。
“沈老板，陆先生不是有耐心的人。这次是商量，下次就不一定了。”
他走了。
沈南枝站在柜台后面，看着他的背影消失在门口。何婉清从仓库回来，手里拿着一个账本，看见沈南枝的脸色，把账本放下。
“陆经纶的律师。”
“来干什么？”
“让我劝陆沉舟回港城。”
何婉清没说话，走到柜台后面，把热水瓶拿起来，倒了两杯水，一杯递给沈南枝，一杯自己端着。喝了一口，放下。
“你怎么说的？”
“我说我跟陆沉舟没关系。”
何婉清看着她，嘴角动了一下。“你说这话的时候，自己信吗？”
沈南枝没回答。
下午，沈南枝去停车场找陆沉舟。
不是为别的事。桂姨让问的——珠珠的药吃完了，郑国良说三副吃完再去看看，问陆沉舟什么时候有空。
她走到停车场门口，看见陆沉舟蹲在伏尔加旁边，正在换轮胎。旁边的地上放着一个搪瓷盆，盆里是水，水里泡着一块抹布，水浑了，抹布也黑了。
他没听见她走过来，手上的扳手在螺丝上使劲，胳膊上的肌肉绷着，额头上有汗，顺着太阳穴往下淌。他抬手用手背擦了一下，汗蹭到袖子上，袖子湿了一小块。

After the fragments were blown away by the wind on the ground, Shen Nanzhi thought the matter was over.
No.
The next afternoon, a man came to the store. The man in his fifties was wearing a black coat, his hair was meticulously combed, and he was holding a brown leather bag in his hand. After entering the door, I looked around first, then scanned the shelves, and finally landed on Shen Nanzhi behind the counter.
"Is this Boss Shen Nanzhi Shen?"
"I am."
"My surname is Liang, and I am Mr. Lu's lawyer." He took out a business card from his wallet and handed it over with both hands. The business card is printed with "Leung Chi-heng, Legal Advisor of Lu Group", and the address is an office building in Central, Hong Kong City.
Shen Nanzhi took the business card, glanced at it, and put it on the counter.
"Which Mr. Lu?"
"Mr. Lu Jinglun." Liang Zhiheng sat down on the chair and put his leather bag on his lap. His movements were natural, as if this was his own office. "Mr. Lu asked me to talk to you."
"What to talk about?"
"Talk about Lu Chenzhou."
Shen Nanzhi leaned behind the counter, looked at him, and said nothing.
Liang Zhiheng took out a folder from his wallet and opened it. There were several pages inside. He didn't hand it to Shen Nanzhi, but put it on the table and pressed it with his fingers.
"Lu Chenzhou is the son of Mr. Lu Jinglun. You should already know this. Mr. Lu is old and hopes that his son will return to inherit the family business. But Lu Chenzhou refused to return to Hong Kong City. The reason - Liang Zhiheng paused and looked at Shen Nanzhi, "It has something to do with you. "
"What does it have to do with me? "
“He said he had something to do in Jinghai. "
Shen Nanzhi's fingers slowly tightened under the counter.
“You talk to him about his matters. What do you want from me? "
Liang Zhiheng closed the folder and put it back in his wallet. He took out an envelope from the inner pocket of his coat, placed it on the table, and pushed it in front of Shen Nanzhi. The envelope was white, unwritten, and bulging.
"This is Mr. Lu's intention. As long as you persuade Lu Chenzhou to return to Hong Kong City, there will be more. "
Shen Nanzhi looked at the envelope and did not move.
"Do you, the Lu family, think that everything can be settled with money? "
Liang Zhiheng's expression did not change, he still had that professional smile.
"Boss Shen, don't get me wrong. Mr. Lu had no other intention, he just wanted his son to come home. We all know your relationship with Lu Chenzhou. He can listen to what you say. "
Shen Nanzhi picked up the envelope and weighed it in his hands. It was not light. She didn't open it, put the envelope back on the table and pushed it back.
“You take it back. I have nothing to do with Lu Chenzhou. He is him and I am me. Whether he can go back or not is up to him, not me. "
Liang Zhiheng looked at her, his eyes stayed on her face for two seconds, nodded, and put the envelope back into his purse. Standing up, he pulled the hem of his coat and smoothed out the wrinkles.
“Boss Shen, Mr. Lu is not a patient person. This time it was a matter of discussion, but next time it won’t be the case. "
He's gone.
Shen Nanzhi stood behind the counter and watched his back disappear through the door. He Wanqing came back from the warehouse with a ledger in her hand. Seeing Shen Nanzhi's face, she put the ledger down.
"Who? "
"Lu Jinglun's lawyer. "
"What are you here for? "
"Let me persuade Lu Chenzhou to return to Hong Kong City. "
He Wanqing said nothing, walked behind the counter, picked up the thermos bottle, poured two glasses of water, handed one to Shen Nanzhi, and held the other for herself. Take a sip and put it down.
"What did you say? "
"I said I have nothing to do with Lu Chenzhou. "
He Wanqing looked at her and moved the corners of her mouth. "When you say this, do you believe it? "
Shen Nanzhi didn't answer.
In the afternoon, Shen Nanzhi went to the parking lot to find Lu Chenzhou.
Not for anything else. Aunt Gui asked - Zhuzhu had finished taking her medicine. Zheng Guoliang said that the third mate would go take a look after eating and asked Lu Chenzhou when he would be free.
She walked to the entrance of the parking lot and saw Lu Chenzhou squatting next to Volga, changing a tire. There was an enamel basin on the ground next to it. There was water in the basin, and a rag soaked in the water. When the water became muddy, the rag turned black.
He didn't hear her coming over, the wrench in her hand was hard on the screw, the muscles in her arms were tense, and there was sweat on her forehead, dripping down her temples. He raised his hand and wiped it with the back of his hand. The sweat rubbed onto his sleeve, making it a little wet.
